# Attack replay results

**30 of 30 attacks from the Burp Suite test script behaved as expected against the running production stack.** Generated by `scripts/attack-replay.js` on 2026-11-09, over real HTTPS through Caddy, against the encrypted two-process stack.

These requests were sent automatically through Burp Suite Community's proxy, so each one appears in its HTTP history. Hand testing with Repeater is recorded separately in the results table of [BURP-TEST-SCRIPT.md](BURP-TEST-SCRIPT.md).

| # | Attack | Expected | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Three wrong passwords, then the right one | 401 every time | Pass |
| 2 | 25 wrong sign-ins for different usernames | 429 after about 20 | Pass |
| 3 | Change the session cookie's value | 401 | Pass |
| 4 | Token with alg none and no signature | 401 | Pass |
| 5 | Replay a request after signing out | 401 | Pass |
| 6 | Password only, skipping the authenticator step | 401 | Pass |
| 7 | Reuse an authenticator code | 401 | Pass |
| 8 | Waiter opens users, audit log and sales report | 403, and an audit entry | Pass |
| 9 | Waiter takes a payment | 403 | Pass |
| 10 | Waiter B edits Waiter A's order | 404 | Pass |
| 11 | Cashier opens an older bill | 404 | Pass |
| 12 | Kitchen snapshot searched for prices and phone numbers | Neither appears | Pass |
| 13 | Manager refunds with no recent authenticator code | 403 step_up_required | Pass |
| 14 | Manager approves their own large refund | 403 same_person | Pass |
| 15 | Add total or price to an order | 400 | Pass |
| 16 | Quantity of -5, 0, 1.5, 100 and "1" | 400 each time | Pass |
| 17 | NoSQL operators in the sign-in form | 401 | Pass |
| 18 | Cashier applies a 50% discount | 403, and an audit entry | Pass |
| 19 | Resend the same Idempotency-Key and body | The first result, and no second record | Pass |
| 20 | Resend that key with a different body | 422 | Pass |
| 21 | Script in a guest's name | Stored as plain text, and the page policy forbids inline script | Pass |
| 22 | Remove the CSRF token | 403 | Pass |
| 23 | Change Origin to another site | 403 | Pass |
| 24 | Remove the Origin header | 403 | Pass |
| 25 | Check response headers | CSP with no unsafe-inline, DENY, nosniff | Pass |
| 26 | HTML uploaded as a PNG | 415, and recorded | Pass |
| 27 | SVG upload | 415 | Pass |
| 28 | Upload over 2 MB | 413 | Pass |
| 29 | Payment callback with no signature | 401, and recorded | Pass |
| 30 | Correct signature sent twice | 204, then 409 | Pass |
